subject.title: fix(gateway): archive legacy-root stale transcript files on reset/delete

question: Should reset/delete runtime archiving accept raw stale `~/.openclaw/sessions/*.jsonl` paths when they realpath under the legacy sessions root?
rationale: The code repair is narrow and tested, but it deliberately broadens a destructive filesystem operation from generated/current paths to raw legacy-root paths; automation can verify containment but cannot own that boundary choice.

options.title: Accept bounded runtime archiving
options.body: Land this PR after current-base validation, keeping the realpath containment and outside-root/symlink regression coverage as the safety contract.

options.title: Defer legacy cleanup to migration or doctor
options.body: Do not merge this runtime path expansion and instead require a doctor/migration-owned cleanup for stale legacy transcript files.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded runtime archiving
recommendation.body: Land this PR after current-base validation, keeping the realpath containment and outside-root/symlink regression coverage as the safety contract.
